info.name: StyleMind Wardrobe — Manage Outfits US-05.01
info.description: Importable local collection for the Manage Outfits APIs of wardrobe-community-service, called through the API Gateway at /wardrobe-community. The internal Commerce lookup is not part of this collection. It needs two verified CUSTOMER test accounts and existing Commerce variants (see the Postman README). Requests create and delete test outfits; never save or export a populated collection or environment into the repository.
